description.narrative: This project convens the biennial meetings of Senior Officials of Law Ministries (SOLM); the Commonwealth Law Ministers (CLMM); and Law Ministers and Attorneys General of Small Commonwealth Jurisdictions (LMSCJ); supporting the building of consensus and collective action on a broad range of legal matters of mutual interest to Commonwealth member states; publication of the Commonwealth Law Bulletin - a refereed journal, that produces articles reflecting the latest developments in member countries and helps foster harmonised approaches to emerging legal issues; convene think-tank type conferences (virtual and in person) raising awareness on how to address key challenges and other legal matters of interest to member countries.
